title: Bellwether Lane Rising
author: Freya Dunmore
blurb: Sebastian Crane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
